capabilities: Scan the vault for checkbox tasks containing YYYY-MM-DD dates
Generate an iCalendar file with events or TODO items from those tasks
Save the calendar to the vault filesystem or a GitHub Gist
Filter tasks by tags, completion status, age, and target directories
Optionally parse Day Planner format tasks with start and end times
disambiguation: It does not display a calendar in Obsidian; it only exports tasks as an iCalendar file for use in other calendar apps.
extras: README includes a detailed privacy section explaining exactly when network requests occur; optional destinations include a custom web URL in addition to GitHub Gist.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to turn dated tasks into a calendar file that external calendar applications can consume.

relations.evidence: This plugin has rudimentary support for Obsidian Tasks emoji format and Obsidian Tasks dataview format.

requires.name: GitHub personal access token and Gist

summary: Generates an iCalendar file from dated tasks in the vault, saving it to disk or a GitHub Gist for subscription in calendar apps.
